description: F45 one-key flip of policy_allow.rewrite (write_file allowed: false) and the F66 constraint policy.
rewrite:
parapet: v1
tools:
  _default:
    allowed: false
  write_file:
    allowed: false
  read_file:
    allowed: true
    constraints:
      path:
        type: string
        starts_with: "/safe/"
layers:
  L3_outbound: { mode: block, block_action: rewrite }
f66:
parapet: v1
tools:
  write_file:
    allowed: true
    constraints:
      path:
        type: string
        starts_with: "/safe/"
        max_length: 5
      content:
        type: string
  typed:
    allowed: true
    constraints:
      n:
        type: number
        min: 1
        max: 3
      url:
        url_host: ["example.com"]
        not_contains: ["evil"]
        matches: "^https://"
        one_of: ["https://example.com/a"]
  denied:
    allowed: false
layers:
  L3_outbound: { mode: block, block_action: rewrite }
